blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— President Donald Trump lands in the Philippines on Tuesday, where he’s expected to meet regional partners, talk trade, and seek a break from a series of setbacks at home ranging from a major disruption to the U.S. aviation industry to a scandal that has shaken the global AI industry. It’s his first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, and, according to Trump, potentially for a meeting with North Korea’s leader Kim Jong Un.
